'''Valantya Tyyre''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was a famous [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] actress.

==Biography==
Valantya was employed by a holovid station and her works included fictional dramas and documentaries. However, in her spare time, she directed propaganda and new pieces for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She also allowed the Alliance to convert [[Apartment 25001|her apartment]] into a safehouse.

==Personality and traits==
Valantya was tall, with dark-colored hair. She had an outgoing personality and was perceptive and intelligent. She was also a competant actress and director.
